label: CCTC Examination Specifications (effective until 2026-06-30)
source: ABTC Candidate Handbook (rev. 3/12/2026), CCTC Examination Specifications effective until 6/30/2026.
_use_note: This is the version a candidate sits BEFORE 2026-07-01. Selectable in the app's blueprint switcher.
_cognitive_note: From the published spec: Recall 52, Application 78, Analysis 20 of 150 scored items.
_organ_note: From the published secondary specifications: 75 organ-specific + 75 general = 150.
_binding_note: The published spec's binding targets are the two SECTION totals (73 / 77). Subsection counts are secondary. The crosswalk below maps each 2026-07 task to its primary legacy subsection; because the two outlines come from different job-task analyses they do not reconcile to the item, so sample to the SECTION totals and treat subsections as soft targets.

subsections.name: Suitability Assessment and Determination of the Potential Transplant Candidate and Living Donor
Living Donor and Candidate Preoperative Care

_crosswalk_note: Maps 2026-07 tasks -> legacy subsection for sampling under this blueprint. A question's legacy_section field (if present) overrides this mapping. Resulting section split: Section 1 gets tasks 0101xx-0105xx + all 02xxxx; Section 2 gets 0106xx, 0107xx + all 03xxxx. Sample to the section totals (73/77); subsection drift is expected and acceptable.
